verdict.rationale: Docs describe a documented API/checkout flow for stablecoin acceptance: creating a payment generates a live quote plus a unique blockchain address (channel), webhooks confirm settlement programmatically, and a sandbox lets developers simulate pay-ins before going live. This covers create-payment, present-address, and confirm-settlement end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond first-party docs, and explicit example of programmatic settlement confirmation logic (webhook payload details).
